name: Power Management
description: Configure macOS power management settings including sleep, display sleep, and Power Nap.

arguments.name: System Sleep
arguments.description: System sleep timeout in minutes. 0 disables sleep.

arguments.name: Display Sleep
arguments.description: Display sleep timeout in minutes. 0 disables display sleep.

arguments.name: Power Nap
arguments.description: Enable or disable Power Nap feature.
